title: fix(objectql): every item a composed stack declares only on its top level, beside package bodies, registers in the engine at boot
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DPW854mdwsCSEDMjDBTfgPx)_

domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwMU5DUWJ6JmbuRpT7

Fixes #28093

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：合成栈（带 `packages[]`）只在顶层声明、没有包体声明的“残留”项，ObjectQL 的 `manifest` 服务以前只把对象、连接器、流程注册进引擎注册表；现在其余所有类型（权限集、岗位、能力、共享规则、队列、分派规则、视图、应用、动作、钩子等）都按包体同类项的同一路径注册，归属栈自己的 `manifest.id` 与版本。
- 为什么改：实测 main 上 28 种残留类型里有 26 种从未进注册表；只问注册表的读者（包括元数据保存门的托管内容封印）把它们当作未声明。安全层面：残留的顶层安全规则没有像包体里的同一规则那样被封印，现在已注册并封印（机制只交维护者）。
- 风险与回滚：注册的东西变多（放宽）；包体已有的判官同样作用于残留项，所以残留项若本身不合规（权限集 `packageId` 指向别的包、视图容器名不一致、动作不合 schema、声明了队列却没组合 ownership-queue 服务）会像包体一样在开机时被拒绝。picklist 维持只进元数据服务。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`（`unclaimedTopLevelItems` 与 `registerUnclaimedTopLevelItems`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts src/manifest-service-residual-security-seal.test.ts`，预期 60 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（欠一次契约复审，席位安排）。

## What changes

- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`.**
  - The `manifest` service reads the residual rule's answer (`unclaimedTopLevel`, `@objectstack/metadata`) once per registration and hands it to both readers (the #28091 contract review's should-fix).
  - `unclaimedTopLevelItemsOfType(stack, 'connector' | 'flow')` becomes `unclaimedTopLevelItems(residual)`: every residual item except the types in `RESIDUAL_TYPES_WITH_OWN_PATH` (`object`, which keeps its own path; `picklist`, which stays metadata-only because the residual objects rule is judged on that premise; `object_extension`, which the residual rule never lists).
  - New `registerUnclaimedTopLevelItems`: after every body and after the residual objects, under the residual rule's id with the stack's version stamped on a shallow copy, through the registration a body's item of that type takes. A `view` container is filed under its object and expanded into its views (ADR-0017) after the one divergent-`name` judge (`viewContainerNameRefusal`); a permission set is judged by the one owner-binding judge (`judgePermissionSetOwnerBinding`, ADR-0086 D3) in the body seam's envelope; every other item is one `registry.registerItem(type, …)`.
  - The late-artifact bound-action target check now judges the residual's actions with the bodies'.
- **`packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts`.** New describe: every formerly dropped type registers under the stack's id and version (one case per type, and all at once); a residual view container registers under its object and expands; a divergent residual view container is refused in the body seam's words; residual queues and assignment rules register when the ownership-queue service is composed, and refuse the boot like a body's when it is not; a residual permission set whose `packageId` names another package is refused; a top-level item a body repeats is the body's, registered once; CONTROL: a stack with no residual item registers exactly the bodies' items.
- **`packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-residual-security-seal.test.ts`** (new). The security pin. Population read from the type registry (every `domain: 'security'` type with `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`): each residual item is registered under the stack's id, an environment save over it is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with nothing stored, and the by-name read still serves the declared permission set.
- **`.changeset/28093-residual-top-level-items-register.md`.** `@objectstack/objectql` patch.

## Why

### Before (measured at `origin/main` `91a423ef`)

A composed stack with `packages[]`, booted through the `manifest` service, whose top level declares one item of each registry type that no body declares:

| Reaches the ObjectQL registry | Types |
|:---|:---|
| yes | `object`, `connector`, `flow` |
| no (metadata service only) | `app`, `view`, `page`, `dashboard`, `report`, `action`, `workflow`, `position`, `permission`, `capability`, `sharing_rule`, `queue`, `assignment_rule`, `api`, `webhook`, `agent`, `tool`, `skill`, `rag_pipeline`, `hook`, `mapping`, `picklist`, `analytics_cube`, `email_template`, `doc`, `book` |

Security, at rule level: a residual top-level rule of type `permission` or `position` was not sealed as managed content the way the same rule in a package body is; now it is registered and sealed. The other security types (`capability`, `sharing_rule`, `queue`, `assignment_rule`) were not reachable the same way. A residual queue or assignment rule on a composition without an ownership-queue service was silently inert, where a body's refuses the boot; it now refuses the same way.

### Why this path

The triage ruling: register each dropped type the way objects, connectors and flows are, or refuse it loudly. Every type is registered; none needed a new refusal. The body seam itself (`registerMetadataCollections`) lives in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (hot file, #25522), outside the claim's surface, so the residual registration calls the same judges and the same shared helpers the body seam calls rather than that method.

### Clause-②

`yes (widening)`: declared residual items that were not registered in the engine now are. What a body's item of the same type is judged by now judges the residual's too, so a residual item a body's would be refused for (an off-contract action, a permission set whose `packageId` names another package, a divergent view container, a queue with no ownership-queue service) now refuses the boot. The divergent view container was already refused by the config boot's metadata door; the others reach only `strict: false` input or a composition without the queue service. `Metadata-protocol: none`: nothing an author can write changes.

## Verification

- New pins red on `origin/main`: 41 of 45 (green there: the two CONTROL pins, the security file's population check and its runtime-create control). Green after: 60 of 60 in the two files.
- Ablations on the committed head (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with `git diff HEAD` empty): residual registration removed → 45 failed (including #28091's connector and flow pins); claim filter dropped → the four body-repeat and CONTROL pins fail; permission owner judge, view expansion and view name judge each removed → exactly its own pin fails.
- `@objectstack/objectql` full suite: 495 files, 9647 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/service-automation` `residual-top-level-flow-boot.test.ts`: 3 passed. `@objectstack/cli` `serve-config-boot-residual.integration.test.ts` (real `os serve` / `os build` / `os validate` boots): 14 passed.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 61 families on the committed head; all run with exit codes recorded. Two exit 3 on the first pass (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` in a shallow clone; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, 10 packages without a dist), both exit 0 after fetching the pinned commit and `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'`. `--ran`: 61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm lint`: exit 0. The head is 17 commits behind `origin/main`; none of them touches the files this diff changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Picklists stay metadata-only.** Registering a residual picklist would change which residual objects the data door serves (the objects rule lists and does not serve an object whose field names a picklist only the residual declares). Left as is; a separate card if wanted.
- **No new refusal was written.** Every type registers; the refusals a residual item can now meet at boot are the ones a package body's item of that type already meets.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's own Chinese reader section).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
